title: Notifications
markAllFailed: Could not mark the notifications as seen.

preferences.title: Notification preferences
preferences.description: Choose which notifications show in the app and which are also sent to you by email.

kind.WATCHERS_MENTIONED: Someone mentions the watchers of a thread I watch
kind.HERE_MENTIONED: Someone mentions the people currently here
kind.EVERYONE_MENTIONED: Someone mentions everyone in a room I am in
kind.THREAD_REPLIED: A reply in a thread I watch
kind.THREAD_CREATED: A new thread in a room I am in
kind.ROOM_ADDED: Someone adds me to a room
kind.THREAD_ASSIGNED: Someone makes me the owner of a thread
kind.THREAD_OWNER_CHANGED: The owner of a thread I watch changes
kind.THREAD_STATUS_CHANGED: A thread I watch moves to another status
kind.THREAD_CLOSED: A thread I watch is closed
kind.THREAD_REOPENED: A thread I watch is reopened

preferences.emailOff: Email is off on this server, so no notification emails are sent. Your choices are kept.
preferences.emailHint: Email is off by default. An email follows only for a notification you have not seen after a few minutes, as one message listing who and where it happened.
preferences.saveFailedNetwork: Saving the choices failed. Check your connection and try again.
